ignore: # crate; its src/ is intentionally a corpus of fixture data,
# negative test cases, parser-boundary vectors, and pinned
# golden values rather than production logic. The repetitions
# jscpd sees there are a feature of fixture-driven testing —
# each negative test case asserts against a fresh input and
# the structure is intentionally independent per case.
# This is the Rust-side equivalent of elang-hub's
# CLI dispatchers repeat the same `match` arms per subcommand;
# the structure is the same as elang-hub's per-route SvelteKit
# page scaffolding which it ignores for the same reason.
